features: First-install and Supercharge buttons for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and OpenRouter; clicks selected before account UI readiness are queued while downloads continue.

Existing ChatGPT/OpenRouter browser flows retained. Claude/Grok download SHA512-pinned unmodified official Windows binaries on click, use vendor-owned isolated profiles and own browser sign-in; Workbench never reads or packages their session tokens.

Explicit Connect and use my plan action enables bounded project-agent delegation; connection display alone does not enable/spend. Claude/Grok are official project agents, not a subscription-token inference API proxy.

Delegated tasks preserve full original brief/current AGENTS/later instructions within bounded request limits. Explicit known no-delegation clauses and registered-project ownership are enforced before handoff. Original project verification remains separate.

Subscription execution respects offline/global local/global free-only/task local/current enable policies. API-key fallback removed, Claude user-only settings+subscription method, Grok API auth disabled/builtin model+provider config guards. Authorized project file edits enabled without broad shell/network permission bypass.

Actual reported token counts are attributed to the project and graph; unknown counts stay unknown. Oversized output is preserved in a private project receipt with valid bounded JSON returned. Oversized Windows argv is rejected, never silently truncated.

Sign-in helpers use hidden Windows process creation and no terminal input. Existing GitHub visible-console flow replaced by hidden official CLI flow and Cale code/copy/browser panel, accessible from donation controls as well as Supercharge. Matching process/generation and fresh account probe required before success; stale account/login events cannot clear current codes.
